output.title: New `iss` short name for Issuer is a convenience addition
output.content: The change only adds the `iss` short name for the `Issuer` resource. The environment's manifests show only apps/v1 Deployment and cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate, and the only installed CRD listed is certificates.cert-manager.io, so nothing shown depends on Issuer short names. Existing resources are not described as changing.
